themes: Shift from time-and-material to fixed-price and outcome-based contracts
Products and solutions acceleration as margin and growth lever
Expansion into new geographies: India, China, Southeast Asia, Middle East, Africa
Off-highway and commercial vehicles emerging as major growth segments
AI/Beacon platform differentiation for integration, validation, and automation
Building organizational resilience and reducing single-client dependency
risks: Two large SDV programs ramp-down in FY27 (planned and surprise Honda program cancellation)
Industry-wide program delays and architecture postponements
Chinese OEM competition expanding globally with platform and ecosystem advantages

analyst_pushback.pushback: Most AD/ADAS spend with new-age OEMs; how do legacy OEMs benefit?
analyst_pushback.response: Validation and simulation is KPIT strength; implementation partner role with platforms; already work with Momenta, Helm, others

analyst_pushback.pushback: How compete with Chinese solutions and quick-to-use IPs at lower cost?
analyst_pushback.response: Chinese ecosystem doesn't work outside China; KPIT solutions localized; trusted partner advantage outside China for Chinese OEMs

analyst_pushback.pushback: 4-5% sequential revenue impact; how will new accounts fully offset?
analyst_pushback.response: New clients are large; first ramp-down is planned production hit; second was surprise; new wins already significant

analyst_pushback.pushback: Chinese competitors invest at negative EBITDA margins; how expand to 22-24% EBITDA?
analyst_pushback.response: Solutions with AI harness provide productivity gains; our competitive advantage outside China stronger; can compete favorably

analyst_pushback.pushback: Is Japan revenue growth sustainable after Honda program stops?
analyst_pushback.response: Broadening to multi-OEM strategy: 3 truck OEMs, 2 large car OEMs targeted; reducing Honda dependency

tone_evidence: Confident on strategy and new markets but cautious on near-term headwinds. Quote: challenging near-term growth, expanded foundation for substantial future expansion and positive FY27 environment with some issues to tackle
